name: Noam Chomsky
notes: Q6: language is primarily an instrument of thought. Q8: Merge appeared suddenly. Q11: classic mysterian.

name: John Searle

name: Christof Koch
notes: Q5: consciousness without report is possible (IIT).

name: Julian Jaynes
notes: Q1: animals see and feel, but 'consciousness' in his sense needs language/metaphor; the clarification forces a yes that misstates him on sensation. Q8: language came first.

name: John Parrington
notes: Q9: tools and language co-shaped human consciousness (Vygotskian).
